# types

Types from PocketBase's Go package `types`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [types](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/types).

## types.DateTime

DateTime represents a [`time.time`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime) instance in UTC that is wrapped
and serialized using the app default date layout.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `time()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime">time.Time</a></code> | Time returns the internal [`time.time`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime) instance. |
| `add()` | <code>(duration: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration">time.Duration</a>): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types#typesdatetime">DateTime</a></code> | Add returns a new DateTime based on the current DateTime + the specified duration. |
| `sub()` | <code>(u: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types#typesdatetime">DateTime</a>): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration">time.Duration</a></code> | Sub returns a [`time.duration`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration) by subtracting the specified DateTime from the current one. |
| `addDate()` | <code>(years: number, months: number, days: number): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types#typesdatetime">DateTime</a></code> | AddDate returns a new DateTime based on the current one + duration. |
| `after()` | <code>(u: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types#typesdatetime">DateTime</a>): boolean</code> | After reports whether the current DateTime instance is after u. |
| `before()` | <code>(u: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types#typesdatetime">DateTime</a>): boolean</code> | Before reports whether the current DateTime instance is before u. |
| `compare()` | <code>(u: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types#typesdatetime">DateTime</a>): number</code> | Compare compares the current DateTime instance with u. If the current instance is before u, it returns -1. If the current instance is after u, it returns +1. If they're the same, it returns 0. |
| `equal()` | <code>(u: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types#typesdatetime">DateTime</a>): boolean</code> | Equal reports whether the current DateTime and u represent the same time instant. Two DateTime can be equal even if they are in different locations. For example, 6:00 +0200 and 4:00 UTC are Equal. |
| `unix()` | <code>(): number</code> | Unix returns the current DateTime as a Unix time, aka. the number of seconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 UTC. |
| `isZero()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | IsZero checks whether the current DateTime instance has zero time value. |
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> | String serializes the current DateTime instance into a formatted UTC date string. |
| `marshalJSON()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | MarshalJSON implements the `json.marshaler` interface. |
| `unmarshalJSON()` | <code>(b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): void</code> | UnmarshalJSON implements the `json.unmarshaler` interface. |
| `value()` | <code>(): any</code> | Value implements the `driver.valuer` interface. |
| `scan()` | <code>(value: any): void</code> | Scan implements `sql.scanner` interface to scan the provided value into the current DateTime instance. |

## types.GeoPoint

GeoPoint defines a struct for storing geo coordinates as serialized json object
(e.g. {lon:0,lat:0}).

Note: using object notation and not a plain array to avoid the confusion
as there doesn't seem to be a fixed standard for the coordinates order.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `lon` | <code>number</code> |  |
| `lat` | <code>number</code> |  |
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> | String returns the string representation of the current GeoPoint instance. |
| `asMap()` | <code>(): { [key: string]: any }</code> | AsMap implements [core.mapExtractor] and returns a value suitable to be used in an API rule expression. |
| `value()` | <code>(): any</code> | Value implements the `driver.valuer` interface. |
| `scan()` | <code>(value: any): void</code> | Scan implements `sql.scanner` interface to scan the provided value into the current GeoPoint instance. |

## types.JSONArray

JSONArray defines a slice that is safe for json and db read/write.

Has everything <code>Array&lt;T&gt;</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `marshalJSON()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | MarshalJSON implements the `json.marshaler` interface. |
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> | String returns the string representation of the current json array. |
| `value()` | <code>(): any</code> | Value implements the `driver.valuer` interface. |
| `scan()` | <code>(value: any): void</code> | Scan implements `sql.scanner` interface to scan the provided value into the current JSONArray`T` instance. |

## types.JSONMap

JSONMap defines a map that is safe for json and db read/write.

Has everything <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `get()` | <code>(key: string): T</code> | Get retrieves a single value from the current JSONMap`T`. |
| `set()` | <code>(key: string, value: T): void</code> | Set sets a single value in the current JSONMap`T`. |
| `marshalJSON()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | MarshalJSON implements the `json.marshaler` interface. |
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> | String returns the string representation of the current json map. |
| `value()` | <code>(): any</code> | Value implements the `driver.valuer` interface. |
| `scan()` | <code>(value: any): void</code> | Scan implements `sql.scanner` interface to scan the provided value into the current JSONMap`T` instance. |

## types.JSONRaw

|---|---|---|

| `value()` | <code>(): any</code> | Value implements the `driver.valuer` interface. |
| `scan()` | <code>(value: any): void</code> | Scan implements `sql.scanner` interface to scan the provided value into the current JSONRaw instance. |
